name: ImplicitSetup
summary: Puts the fixture in a method the framework calls before every test, so that every test in the class starts from the same state without saying so.

roles.name: ImplicitSetup
roles.summary: The setUp the framework runs. It removes the repetition and takes the setup out of the reader's line of sight, which is the trade: a test that fails now has a cause that is not in the test — and nothing in the test says where to look.
